text:
Maggie: Heads-up — planning a staging soak to validate per-key bursts + per-org quotas under long-tail spiky traffic. Looking for volunteers to run the harness and review telemetry/dashboards. 

Tony: What traffic shape are you thinking? sudden spikes, paced bursts, or heavy tails?

Maggie: Long-tail spikes. Mix of steady baseline (10 rps per key) + occasional sharp bursts (up to 2k rps) from ~5% of synthetic keys. Want to validate: per-key token bucket refill, shared org quota backpressure, and fallback routing when dedicated capacity is exhausted.

Sam: Will the harness impersonate both hosted API keys and dedicated-tenant keys? Need to ensure we don't accidentally hit prod.

Maggie: staging only, keys are test-only. Harness tags requests with header `x-test-run: longtail-burst-2026-03-18`. No real customer keys.

Tony: I'll prepare a vegeta config. Quick draft:
```
echo "POST https://staging.api.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=R -duration=30s -header "Authorization: Bearer test-KEY" -header "x-test-run: longtail-burst-2026-03-18" | vegeta report
```
Replace R with dynamic ramp script (baseline 10 -> spike windows).

Janet: I'll add dashboard panels: `quota.available_tokens` (per_key), `quota.replenish_rate`, `quota.shared_org_balance`, `rl.denied_ratio`, `route.fallback_counts`. Also add a histogram for latency under 429.

Kevin: Important: token refill is wall-clock-based. If we run multi-node generator with slight time drift we might see weird refill anomalies. Suggest we also include `sys/clock_skew` health check and log `quota.clock_offset_ms` per shard.

Sam: Can we simulate a burst that targets keys across multiple routing pools? We should assert fallback routing picks correct variant (cheaper model) instead of hard 429 for tiered customers.

Maggie: Yes — test will include two routing groups: `primary-gpu` and `fallback-cpu`. Plan: send 80% of burst to primary until capacity hits SLO, then hold and observe routing fallback events.

eng-bot: [automated] staging cluster: test image `cicd/inference:staging-20260318-rr` deployed to pool `staging-gpu-01` at 2026-03-18T15:02:10Z.

Tony: Minor note on metrics: we need per-request tag `quota.reason` with values like `per_key_limit`, `org_limit`, `fallback_routed` so we can pivot quickly.

Janet: Added panels + a quick alert: if `rl.denied_ratio` > 0.5 for >2m during test, page eng-platform on-call. Alert channel `#incidents` muted for test runs but logged.

Maggie: For observability, also request emitting `quota.bucket_size_at_denial` and `quota.tokens_consumed_window_30s`. Those help prove whether the denial was due to burst exhaustion or sustained usage.

Kevin: Agree. Also please include a synthetic trace sample when a request is fallback-routed so we can see where decision happened (router -> policy engine -> runtime).

Sam: I'll run the harness from three hosts to emulate geo-distributed clients. Will attach harness logs and a TL;DR at the end.

Maggie: Important ops instruction: feature flag `rl.enforce_per_key` should be ON for the run, but `rl.strict_blocking` should be OFF to allow fallback routing instead of immediate hard-block for org-tier customers. We want to verify graceful degradation.

deploy-bot: [featureflag] toggled `rl.enforce_per_key` -> ON in staging at 2026-03-18T15:05:00Z by Maggie.

Tony: One more: include a replay scenario where bursts are correlated (many keys spike simultaneously vs random distribution). That helps exercise quota smoothing vs burst regen.

Janet: Dashboards configured to tag metrics with `test_run: longtail-burst-2026-03-18` and `traffic_pattern` so we can filter. Saved panel: `quota_replay_summary_longtail`.

Sam: Starting run in 10m. Will post short log excerpt and aggregate metrics after each 30m window.

Kevin: If we see >10% increased latency on fallback routes, capture heap and GPU queue depth — might indicate model cold-starts under fallback.

Maggie: Goals for the test:
- Verify per-key bucket refill math matches documented rate and observed replenish metrics.
- Confirm shared org quota prevents noisy-neighbor escalation.
- Ensure fallback routing works and telemetry shows clear `quota.reason` labels.
- Validate dashboard/alerting for quick ops response.

Sam: run started. baseline 2h soak with 3 spike episodes per 30m window. tagging artifacts.

Tony: quick note: saw early 429s from `per_key_limit` for ~120 keys, but `quota.shared_org_balance` stayed above threshold. Looks like burst tokens drained as expected. sending sample request/response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Quota-Reason: per_key_limit
X-Remaining-Tokens: 0
{ "error": "burst tokens exhausted" }
```

Janet: Received metric emit: `quota.tokens_consumed_window_30s{key=~"test-*"} = 520` on one spike. Grafana panel shows replenish lag ~1.2s.

Sam: After first hour, fallback routing engaged 1.3k times, majority for low-priority keys — looks good.

Maggie: Great. Post-run checklist: upload harness logs to the `staging-soaks` bucket, create a short run report with: top-5 failing keys, time-series for `rl.denied_ratio`, examples of fallback traces, and suggested config changes if refill math off by >10%.

Tony: I'll open a follow-up PR to add `quota.reason` header to all 429 responses and to ensure it's present in traces.

Kevin: If team comfortable, we should schedule a quick retro tomorrow to decide if the default burst sizes need tuning for multi-tenant staging profiles.

Maggie: Thanks all — tagging @Tony @Janet @Sam for quick post-run sync at 17:30 PT. :thumbsup:

Sam: Logs uploaded: gs://redwood-staging/staging-soaks/longtail-burst-2026-03-18/logs.tar.gz

Tony: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/rate-limiter/pull/482 — adds `quota.reason` header and unit tests.

Janet: Dashboards shared with `eng-platform` team and saved as `longtail-burst-2026-03-18` for replay comparisons.

Maggie: Closing the loop — initial pass looks like behavior is within expectations, leaving notes in the run report. Will schedule tuning if we see production pattern match. Thanks team. :rocket:
